div.p:
Schedule Type:
• After Lead Creation: Schedule based on delay from when the lead is created
• After Previous Activity Completed: Schedule based on delay from when the previous reminder's activity is marked as done
Example: If delay is "3 Days" and schedule type is "After Lead Creation", the activity will be scheduled 3 days after the lead is created.
